rust.Cargo.toml:
[workspace]
members = ["crates/*"]
resolver = "3"

[workspace.package]
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"

[workspace.dependencies]
serde_json = "1.0"
shop-core = { path = "crates/core", version = "0.1.0" }
shop-storage = { path = "crates/storage", version = "0.1.0" }
shop-api = { path = "crates/api", version = "0.1.0" }

[workspace.lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
missing_docs = "warn"

[workspace.lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
rust.crates/api/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "shop-api"
description = "The shop's request handler: text in, status and body out"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true

[dependencies]
shop-core = { workspace = true }

[dev-dependencies]
shop-storage = { workspace = true }

[lints]
workspace = true
rust.crates/cli/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "shop-cli"
description = "The shop on the command line"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true

[features]
# Off by default: `--db <file>` needs the file-backed catalog.
file = ["shop-storage/file"]

[dependencies]
shop-core = { workspace = true }
shop-storage = { workspace = true }
shop-api = { workspace = true }

[[bin]]
name = "shop"
path = "src/main.rs"

[lints]
workspace = true
rust.crates/core/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "shop-core"
description = "The shop's domain types and the Catalog trait"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true

[lints]
workspace = true
rust.crates/storage/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "shop-storage"
description = "Catalog implementations: in memory, and (feature `file`) in a file"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
rust-version.workspace = true
license.workspace = true

[features]
# Off by default: `FileCatalog` needs serde_json.
file = ["dep:serde_json"]

[dependencies]
shop-core = { workspace = true }
serde_json = { workspace = true, optional = true }

[lints]
workspace = true

# Keep short struct literals and calls on one line.
use_small_heuristics = "Max"
